svg.text: Normalize each unknown analyte by UV
Measure initial absorbance at 281.5 nm and dilute a separate
aliquot until A281.5=2.6. Exact dilution and mixing aliquots
unreported. Use normalized samples for the QD array; base-
dependent concentrations given in Figure S10. Retain the initial
